div.head: Northu 12
div.ab: Gif preost on unriht ut of scire had begite, gilde XII ór, ⁊ diacon VI ór; ⁊ þolian his hades, buton scirebiscop heom hades geunne.
Gif preost on unriht ut of scire had begite, gilde XII or, and diacon VI or; and þolie his hades, buton scirebiscop him hades geunne.

Wenn ein Priester unrechtmässig, ausserhalb der Diöcese, die Weihe nimmt, zahle er 12 Ör, und ein Diakon 6 Ör; und sie sollen [jeder diese] seine Weihe verlieren, wenn ihnen nicht der Diöcesanbischof die Weihe belassen will.

If a priest wrongfully obtains ordination outside the diocese, let him pay 12 ores, and a deacon 6 ores; and let them [each] lose his orders, unless the diocesan bishop grants them [to keep] their orders.
If a priest wrongly obtain ordination outside the diocese, he is to pay 12 ores, and a deacon 6 ores; and each is to lose his orders unless the bishop of the diocese acknowledges the ordination.

If a priest wrongfully receives ordination outside of his diocese, he is to pay twelve oras and a deacon six oras; and he is to forfeit his ordination unless the bishop of the diocese permits him to retain it.
div.note: ‘þolian his’ stands so in D.; U: checked against Whitelock, EHD I (1979), and corrected (before: ‘If a priest wrongly obtain ordination outside the diocese, he is to pay 12 ores, and a deacon six ores; and each is to lose his orders unless the bishop of the diocese acknowledges the ordination.’).
